verdict.rationale: CrewAI is itself an official open-source Python framework/SDK. Its documented programmatic API covers Agent, Task, Crew, Process, Flows and the Memory class, it installs via `uv tool install crewai`, and it ships official CLI scaffolding plus official skills for coding agents, so developers can clearly build against first-party code. Missing for 10: any evidence of SDKs in languages beyond Python, an official client SDK for the AMP REST API (kickoff/status/resume), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s), and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.
